faqs.a: As a guide: Plan & Prepare from ¥60,000, the Launch Package from ¥250,000, and ongoing support from ¥50,000 per month (excluding tax). After a free consultation, we send a formal quote based on your scope.

faqs.q: Can you handle my visa or company registration?
faqs.a: No. Visa and permit applications are performed by licensed administrative scriveners, and company registration by judicial scriveners. We introduce trusted partners and coordinate with them.

faqs.q: Do you file taxes or handle social insurance?
faqs.a: No. Tax filing and advice are reserved for licensed tax accountants, and social-insurance filings for labor and social security attorneys. We set up bookkeeping and introduce the right professional.
Yes. We communicate in English, help you understand Japanese documents and tools, and join meetings with banks and professionals as bilingual support (not as your legal representative).

faqs.q: Can you help before I arrive in Japan?
faqs.a: Yes. Planning, projections, and the roadmap can all be done online before you arrive. We also prepare the materials you will need once you are here.
